[entry: photon] The electromagnetic photon: massless spin-1 gauge boson mediating th

phase_0.boundary_condition: light-tight housing plus closed exposure record that contains optics, sensor, bias electronics and count log
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.chosen_element: photon transit through window, filter and absorber toward multiplication region
AFWD.justification: optical coupling drives the incident field forward into charge generation

AREV.chosen_element: active quench pulling bias below breakdown then recharging
AREV.justification: reverse bias step collapses the avalanche and restores the field for the next arrival

CLINK.chosen_element: absorption chained to avalanche gain chained to comparator shaping
CLINK.justification: photoelectron creation links directly into multiplication and logic pulse formation

ENGAGR.chosen_element: pileup window where photon pulse and dark pulse overlap in time
ENGAGR.justification: coincident arrivals hold affirmed and denied counts together until timing logic separates them

EVALF.chosen_element: subthreshold fluctuation or rejected dark pulse with no count
EVALF.justification: charge failing threshold or vetoed by gating denies a photon event

EVALT.chosen_element: above-threshold avalanche registered as photon detection
EVALT.justification: charge exceeding comparator level affirms a countable event

FFUSE.chosen_element: discriminator input node merging both carrier paths
FFUSE.justification: photon and dark avalanches rejoin into one threshold decision that yields a single count line

FSPLIT.chosen_element: carrier origin divergence into photon-induced versus thermally generated paths
FSPLIT.justification: one armed state opens into a true photoelectron arm and a dark carrier arm

IFIX.chosen_element: time-to-digital timestamp appended to event memory
IFIX.justification: written arrival time cannot be erased and anchors later photon counting statistics

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: channel identifier and clock reference stamped on each logic pulse
IMSCRIB.justification: detector recognizes its own output by marking origin pixel and time base

TANCH.chosen_element: sealed exposure file with total counts and timestamps
TANCH.justification: closed record bounds the measurement interval and returns the sensor to ready state

VINIT.chosen_element: armed SPAD biased above breakdown in darkness
VINIT.justification: idle detector holds no charge and no timestamp before a carrier appears

phase_2.fuse_element: discriminator input node merging both carrier paths
phase_2.fuse_result: one shaped logic pulse stream feeding the counter, containing true counts, dark counts and coincident pileup states
phase_2.rejoin_note: photon arm undergoes gain multiplication and shaping while dark arm undergoes quench and veto filtering, then both arms meet at the comparator threshold and continue as one count line
phase_2.split_element: carrier origin divergence into photon-induced versus thermally generated paths
phase_2.split_input: single photoexcited or thermally excited electron entering the high field region
split_outputs: photon-driven avalanche arm with optical timing correlation
dark carrier arm from thermionic emission and trap release
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) both held at once: pileup coincidence where photon and dark signatures overlap
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) constructively refuted: pulse below threshold or gated out as non photon
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) constructively proven: avalanche above threshold counted as photon
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) neither: armed detector with no carrier and no decision

steps.domain_action: detector sits armed above breakdown in darkness awaiting a carrier
incident photon passes window and spectral filter into absorber
photocathode absorption ejects photoelectron into multiplication field
carrier population branches by photon-induced versus thermally generated origin
photon-born electron initiates self sustaining avalanche
avalanche gain multiplies charge toward comparator level
thermal carrier triggers dark avalanche or subthreshold noise transient
quench circuit collapses avalanche and recharges bias toward armed level
photon and dark charge paths rejoin at discriminator input
overlapping photon and dark pulses held together through coincidence window
comparator thresholds merged signal and shapes clean logic pulse
logic pulse marked with pixel address and clock reference
timestamp and channel address written to append-only event log
exposure record sealed and detector rearmed for next photon

phase_5.alfs_store: calibration table of photon detection efficiency, dark count rate and afterpulsing probability
phase_5.compiler_frontend: bias controller and optical stack that translate photon flux into countable charge pulses
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: analog avalanche current coupled to comparator and digital trigger lines within the module
phase_5.memory_mechanism: circular buffer plus append-only timestamp log backed by counter registers
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: gate generator, dead time controller and quench timer that order arm, fire and reset phases

phase_6.cycle_cost: bias charge dissipated as heat during avalanche plus quench recharge energy per count
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — bias energy inflow balances heat outflow across one detect quench reset cycle
phase_6.post_cycle_state: recharged sensor with one added timestamp and incremented counter
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: armed high field state with empty event log and stabilized temperature
